accommodation.about: [Cheongpyeonghada] derives from the Korean words meaning integrity and fairness — the very etymology of the Cheongpyeong region. We remain steadfast in running this space with honesty and care, crafting a clear and peaceful sanctuary. Let us comfort your weary days like a deep, restful sleep.

items.a: It is a private riverside pension at 2209 Bukhangang-ro, Cheongpyeong-myeon, Gapyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do, Korea. It is about 50 minutes by car from Seoul (Cheongpyeong IC) and about 10 minutes by taxi from Cheongpyeong Station on the Gyeongchun Line.

items.q: Is it a private whole-house rental in Cheongpyeong?
items.a: Yes. There is only one two-level house (about 165㎡ indoors) on roughly 2,000㎡ of grounds, so a single booking has the lawn and the Bukhan River view to itself.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in is at 3:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM. Please complete check-in before 8:00 PM.
The base rate covers 2 guests, with a maximum of 6. Each extra guest is ₩30,000 (free under 12 months), and an extra bedding set for two is ₩20,000.
Yes. The host grills a wood-fired oak barbecue for you for ₩50,000. Advance booking is required.

items.q: How do I make a reservation?
items.a: Fill out the inquiry form on this site. Your details are copied and an Instagram DM to @cheongpyung_hada opens, so you can paste and send them. We will get back to you after checking.
Cancellations 15+ days before the stay get a 100% refund, 14 days before 90%, and 13 to 8 days before 50%. No refund from 7 days before through the day of stay, or for no-shows.
